# SMCSolver Library

This is a Python port of the SMCSolver toolbox originally implemented in
MATLAB and located at the following directories in the LINE solver repository:

- `matlab/lib/thirdparty/smcsolver/`
- `matlab/lib/thirdparty/MG1files/`
- `matlab/lib/thirdparty/QBDfiles/`

SMCSolver provides numerical methods for solving structured Markov chains,
including M/G/1-type, GI/M/1-type, and Quasi-Birth-Death (QBD) processes
using matrix-analytic techniques.

## Author

Original MATLAB code by Prof. Benny Van Houdt, University of Antwerp.

## Origin

This code is a derivative work ported from MATLAB to Python for use in the
native Python implementation of the LINE solver.
